newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ASM INT SEES LOWER Q4 96, H1 97 EARNINGS.
newsitem.headline: ASM INT SEES LOWER Q4 96, H1 97 EARNINGS.

text.p: Semiconductor equipment maker ASM International NV said on Monday it expected earnings for the fourth quarter of 1996 and the first two quarters of 1997 to be "substantially below" the levels of a year earlier.

"In view of the uncertainties which currently prevail in the semi-conductor industry, the company is viewing the fourth quarter of 1996 and the first two quarters of 1997 with caution and, consequently, expects that net sales and earnings in such quarters will be substantially below corresponding quarters from the prior year," the company said.
ASM said the semiconductor industry had grown vigorously in the last two decades, driven by increasing use of personal computers (PCs) and developments in telecommunications.
The company said its sales and earnings mirrored the investments of the industry, with periods of strong growth being followed by stagnation during periods over overcapacity.
Between 1981 and 1995, revenue excluding significant spin-offs rose to 670 million guilders from about 100 million while net income grew to almost 74 million from 6 million.
Net income in the first nine months of 1996 of 61.2 million guilders was 34 percent ahead of a year earlier.
But third quarter net income of 6.8 million guilders was 71 percent down on the same period in 1995.
For the first half of 1996, net income rose 41.5 percent to 27.5 million guilders.
